text:
Type: pink heart-shaped textured cushion
Use: decoration on a bed, sofa or armchair; bedroom, children's room, living room
Style: glam, contemporary, bohemian
Materials: ruffled smocked fabric with a bubbly raised texture, soft filling
Colors: soft lilac pink
Shape: plump heart outline, dense rows of small ruffles that make a rippled, quilted surface, rounded thick edges, small and cuddly
Feel: sweet, playful, romantic
Goes with: white or blush bedding, grey sofas, light wood; girls' rooms, romantic or playful bedrooms

product.name: SRBAR
product.description: Your child can place this heart-shaped cushion on the bed or a chair to create a unique atmosphere in their room.
